play_equipment.evidence: A round dark disc with a lighter rim sits west of the central house, partly shaded by trees. It could be a trampoline but may be a cover or planter.

signals.notes: Central house has a gray-brown roof with some uneven staining. Two dark cars are parked in the driveway at the lower right, and heavy tree canopy covers the west and south sides of the lot, so the backyard is largely hidden.
